The GPPV homological invariants $\hat{H}_a(M_3)$ / $\hat{Z}$: the Hilbert space of BPS states of the 6d fivebrane on $M_3 \times D^2$ categorifies WRT / the 3d $\mathcal{N}=2$ $T[M_3]$ indices ($D^2\times S^1$ half-index, $S^2\times S^1$ superconformal / twisted index). For QOU this is the **closed** / state-integral BPS sector that supplies the BPS-Hilbert-space realization of the resurgent-Stokes = DT count behind $A_\omega$ (the licensing bridge, with garoufalidis-gu-marino2023peacock Conjecture 3(d) and dimofte-gaiotto-gukov2013) — distinct from the OPEN-HOMFLY sector of gukov-stosic2012.
